headline: CodeBuild deploy role has full AdministratorAccess — any build job can do anything in the account
suppressed: The CodeBuild service principal in the trust policy is expected for a pipeline deploy role and is not reported on its own.

findings.evidence_ref: iam.tf: new aws_iam_role_policy.deploy sets Action "*" / Resource "*" on aws_iam_role.deploy
findings.explanation: The policy is functionally identical to AdministratorAccess. Any CodeBuild job that assumes this role — including a compromised or hijacked build — can create IAM users, exfiltrate secrets, delete production databases, or backdoor the account with no further escalation needed.
